title: [AUG-200] Show ACTION ITEMS and ASSISTANT columns during a Default-mode recording
why_we_need_this: The ACTION ITEMS and ASSISTANT columns (AUG-199) only appear while Live Text runs. In a Default-mode recording (`recordingMode: 'default'`, no live transcript) the user cannot write down agreements or ask Claude about the project during the meeting. They have to start Live Text, which means sending audio to Groq or loading the local whisper live engine, just to get a to-do list and a chat. Without live text there is nothing to extract items from automatically, so in Default mode action items come from only two sources: the user adds them by hand, or the Assistant adds them (`add_action_item` / `→ Action item`).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] During a Default-mode recording (no Live client) the main window shows the ACTION ITEMS and ASSISTANT columns. They collapse, hide and resize the same way as in Live mode, and the pin-bar toggles `[ ACTION ITEMS ] [ ASSISTANT ]` are shown.
- [ ] "Add an item" in the ACTION ITEMS column creates a manual locked item (`manual: true`, source Me), as in Live mode.
- [ ] In the ASSISTANT column the user can open a project tab and chat with Claude. Both `→ Action item` and the `add_action_item` tool add items to the same list.
- [ ] No Groq or local-model action-item extraction runs in Default mode. No audio or text leaves the machine except through the Claude session the user opened.
- [ ] Without a transcript, `get_recent_transcript` returns an empty result instead of an error. The chat does not show the '+ last N min of the transcript' sub-line, and the Assistant still answers from Praxis context.
- [ ] The COPILOT column is not shown in Default mode, because it has no transcript to work from.
- [ ] Items survive End Meeting. They land in the session's action items (TranscriptView card and the `transcript.md` Action items section) and can be exported to Praxis through the existing flow (AUG-166).
- [ ] When "Start Live Text again" (AUG-188) is pressed during a Default recording, the items and the Assistant tab are kept and automatic extraction starts from that moment.
- [ ] Compact Mode: during a Default recording the Dock Strip / Ghost Caption action-items panel and the compact Assistant window are available.
- [ ] Unit tests cover the action-items store and the august MCP running without a LiveFeed transcript. Typecheck passes for client, server and electron.
- [ ] Checked on Windows. Anything specific to macOS (compact windows) is listed for checking on macOS.
important_constraints:
- Context: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md (AUG-199 columns, august MCP, LiveFeed), @project-context/frontend-design/README.md (Live columns, LiveColumnToggles), @project-context/transcription/live-transcription/README.md (manual items, liveKey store, Start Live Text again).
- Today the action-items store and the assistant are keyed by `liveKey` and created at action-items-init together with Live. Default mode needs a key or store bound to the recording (session) without starting Live Text. Choose the approach in Step 4 and write the decision into the context.
- Do not change Live-mode behaviour: Groq/local extraction, dedup and model locks (AUG-165/168) stay as they are.
- In Default mode, do not acquire a LiveFeed for the transcript and do not start whisper live.
- Cross-platform: Windows + macOS. Do not break the compact windows (electron/src/compact.ts) on either platform.
- Brandbook: 0 border-radius, no diagnostics in the UI.
- Open question for the user: should Default mode get its own column-layout key, or reuse the Live one (`august.liveColumns.v1.*`)? Default: reuse the Live key.
